open_source.overview: Guidance for contributing to Travel-Book, including forking, branching, committing, and raising PRs aligned with repository guidelines.

faqs.a: Fork the backend repository (https://github.com/Sahilll94/Travel-Book-Backend), clone your fork, create a feature branch (e.g., feat/chatbot-kb), make changes, test locally, push to your fork, and open a PR to the upstream repository. Follow CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.

faqs.q: What branch workflow should I use?
faqs.a: Use short-lived feature branches named by scope (feat/..., fix/..., docs/...). Keep commits atomic with clear messages. Rebase or merge from upstream main before opening the PR to resolve conflicts.

faqs.q: How do I link issues in my PR?
faqs.a: Reference the issue number in your PR description using keywords like 'Fixes #94' or 'Closes #94' so GitHub auto-links and closes on merge.
See CONTRIBUTING.md in both frontend and backend repos and QUICK_START_CONTRIBUTORS.md in backend for environment setup and expectations.

project.overview: Project-specific features, structure, and usage of Travel-Book.
features: Create, edit, delete travel stories with images
Cloudinary image uploads and optimized storage
Search and filter stories by location, date, keywords
Social and email authentication (Google, GitHub, Twitter, OTP)
usage: Backend dev: set environment variables as per .env.example and run 'npm install' then 'npm run dev' or 'node index.js'
API base URLs: Development http://localhost:5000, Production https://api.travelbook.sahilfolio.live/

developer.overview: Common developer and platform-related questions for setup and troubleshooting.

faqs.q: Which Node.js version should I use?
faqs.a: Use an active LTS (e.g., Node 18+). Check package.json engines if specified and align with deployment environment.
See .env.example. Typical keys include GEMINI_API_KEY, MongoDB URI, Firebase credentials, JWT secrets, Cloudinary keys.

faqs.q: How do I run tests or verify changes?
faqs.a: Run the backend locally, exercise affected endpoints (e.g., /chatbot). Add unit/integration tests where applicable or provide manual test plan in the PR.
See README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, QUICK_START_CONTRIBUTORS.md, and repository-specific documentation.
